categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Modifies FinalizePSBT in src/psbt.cpp exposed by the finalizepsbt RPC; wallet category guidance explicitly notes that PSBT changes without wallet code belong to rpc.
categories.rationale: Fixes a bug where finalizepsbt returns complete: true and an invalid raw transaction hex when input witness or scriptSig scripts are invalid. In RPC, correctness of returned data is high priority, and returning a transaction that fails mempool verification while claiming completion directly violates expected RPC contract behavior.

categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Touches only src/psbt.cpp and functional tests without wallet code; the wallet category explicitly notes that PSBT changes affecting only RPC without wallet code are rpc, not wallet.
categories.rationale: Not a member per the category guideline classifying non-wallet PSBT/RPC changes under rpc.
